title: Carbon monoxide poisoning (Medical Encyclopedia)
licence_note: US federal government work (NLM); A.D.A.M. encyclopedia text, licensed for NLM display. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: move to fresh air and seek care; hospitals give oxygen, sometimes hyperbaric; permanent brain damage may occur; impaired mental ability can reappear after 1 to 2 symptom-free weeks.

title: Hydrocarbon pneumonia (Medical Encyclopedia)
licence_note: US federal government work (NLM); A.D.A.M. encyclopedia text, licensed for NLM display. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: caused by drinking or breathing in gasoline, kerosene, furniture polish, paint thinner; do not use ipecac to make the person throw up; store these products safely around young children.

title: ToxFAQs: Ethylene Glycol
org: CDC / Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry (ATSDR)
licence_note: US federal government work. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: ethylene glycol is used in antifreeze; odorless with a sweet taste; antifreeze is sweet-tasting and brightly colored, so accidental ingestion occurs; very small amounts tasted are unlikely to cause serious effects, larger amounts can cause serious illness or death (kidney damage, acid-base change).

title: Boiled Linseed Oil (product 872): Use and Safety Information
licence_note: Manufacturer document; archived for personal offline reference; do not redistribute. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: rags, steel wool or waste soaked with boiled linseed oil may spontaneously catch fire if improperly discarded; immediately after each use place them in a sealed, water-filled metal container; the time frame and conditions are unpredictable.

title: Hand and Power Tools (OSHA 3080)
licence_note: US federal government work. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: keep all tools in good condition; use the right tool; impact tools such as chisels, wedges and drift pins with mushroomed heads may shatter on impact, sending sharp fragments flying; dull tools can cause more hazards than sharp ones; appropriate PPE for flying objects.

title: NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards: Zinc oxide
licence_note: US federal government work. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: exposure route inhalation; symptoms: metal fume fever (chills, muscle ache, nausea, fever, dry throat, cough, weakness, metallic taste, headache, chest tightness, breathing difficulty).

title: 49 CFR 574.5, Tire identification requirements
org: Cornell Legal Information Institute (text of the US Code of Federal Regulations)
licence_note: US federal regulation text. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: the date code, four numerical symbols, is the final group of the tire identification number; first two symbols are the week, last two the year of manufacture (example 0109 = first week of 2009).

title: 29 CFR 1926.1053, Ladders
org: Cornell Legal Information Institute (text of the US Code of Federal Regulations)
licence_note: US federal regulation text (OSHA construction standard). Read 2026-11-16 by R13: portable ladder side rails extend at least 3 feet above the upper landing surface, or the top is secured; non-self-supporting ladder base set out about one-quarter of the working length; used only on stable, level surfaces unless secured; face the ladder; at least one hand on it; carry no load that could cause a fall.

title: Emergency Shut Off (natural gas meter valve)
licence_note: Utility safety page; archived for personal offline reference. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: use a 12-inch or larger adjustable wrench; turn the valve a quarter turn clockwise; tang parallel to the pipe = ON, crosswise = OFF; if you turn the gas off at the meter do not turn it back on yourself; a technician restores service and relights pilots.

title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Begin FEMA's Operation Blue Roof in Nine Florida Counties
licence_note: US federal government work. Read 2026-11-16 by R13: Operation Blue Roof provides a temporary covering of blue plastic sheeting installed using strips of wood secured to the roof with nails or screws; primary residences with standard shingled roofs; roofs with more than 50 percent structural damage not eligible.

title: Operation Maintenance Service Manual, 600 - 8,000 lbs. capacity (LIT-001-00, 3/11)
licence_note: Manufacturer manual, read from a copy hosted by a trailer maker (the Dexter literature page cannot be fetched). Read 2026-11-16 by R13: new axles: wheel nut torque at 10, 25 and 50 miles; wheel nuts torqued before first road use and after each wheel removal, re-torqued after the first 10, 25 and 50 miles; bearings lubricated every 12 months or 12,000 miles; E-Z Lube: pump grease slowly, rotate the hub, stop when new grease shows; pneumatic grease guns can force grease past the seal.
